prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: use Yext if you want one paid service focused on feeding and tracking your business in the AI/LLM ecosystem. For an inexpensive audit and ongoing local-visibility monitoring, BrightLocal or Moz Local are the most practical choices for small businesses.

Why
- Yext specializes in a business “knowledge graph” that feeds search engines and LLMs (it has integrations for ChatGPT and other AI products). It’s designed to make sure canonical facts about your business are available to generative models and gives reporting on how your data is used.
- BrightLocal and Moz Local are cheaper, focus on local citations/listings and rank/review tracking, and let you see how visible you are across directories that LLMs often draw from.

How to check right now (practical steps)
1. Claim and optimize your Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect and Yelp listings (these are primary sources used by many AI features).
2. Run a citations/listings audit with BrightLocal, Moz Local or Whitespark to find missing or inconsistent listings.
3. Use Yext if you want an enterprise-style single source of truth and direct LLM integrations (paid).
4. Add structured data (schema.org/LocalBusiness) to your website and ensure NAP consistency (name, address, phone).
5. Manually test LLMs:
   - Ask ChatGPT, Bing Chat and Google Bard prompts like “Recommend coffee shops near 94103” and “What are top-rated [your business type] near [city/zip]?” Try multiple phrasings and include your business name.
   - Use incognito and provide location context in the prompt so the model can give local recommendations.
6. Consider a direct integration:
   - Build a ChatGPT plugin or a Custom GPT (or work with Yext) so ChatGPT can fetch authoritative, up-to-date info about your business.
7. Monitor reviews and local SEO metrics regularly (BrightLocal, ReviewTrackers, Chatmeter).

Notes and caveats
- LLMs may use different data sources and can hallucinate — absence from a model’s answer doesn’t necessarily mean your business isn’t listed somewhere.
- There’s no single public “AI index” that tells you definitively if every model recommends you; the best approach is to make your data authoritative and available to the major directories and LLM connectors.

If you want, tell me your city/type of business and budget and I’ll recommend the exact service and a 30–60 day checklist you can follow.
